title: Modular Process Systems
summary: Custom-engineered modular process systems integrating pressure vessels, heat exchangers, piping, instrumentation interfaces and selected auxiliary equipment for industrial applications.
body:
Tongyang Process provides engineering coordination, equipment fabrication and package integration support for modular process systems and skid-mounted equipment packages.

Depending on project requirements, our scope may include pressure vessels, heat exchangers, separators, piping, valves, instrumentation interfaces and selected auxiliary equipment.

We work with clients and engineering partners to establish the equipment configuration, applicable design standards, system interfaces, fabrication requirements and testing procedures.

The final scope of engineering, automation, installation and commissioning is determined according to the agreed project specifications.
seoTitle: Modular Process Skids & Equipment Packages | Tongyang Process
seoDescription: Modular process skids and integrated equipment packages including pressure vessels, heat exchangers, piping and auxiliaries for industrial applications.
